title: Routing & Quota Signalboard — Standup notes
content:
Attendees: Priya (owner), Ethan, Sofia, Luca, Maya (SRE cameo)

Purpose: quick weekly signalboard focused on routing + quota interactions that tripped last week. Keep it lightweight — capture decisions, blockers, and owners.

Quick summary:
- Observed spike in quota-reject-rate starting 2026-12-09 03:20 UTC; peak 0.9% for 40 minutes, primarily requests routed to eu-west-1 Dedicated pool.
- Root-cause hypothesis: combined effect of an aggressive autoscaler change (PLAT-1345) + routing weight update that sent more bursty low-priority traffic to a smaller pool.
- Auth token churn caused ephemeral-key validation timeouts (~50ms extra latency) that pushed some requests past the 300ms routing cutoff and triggered quota fast-path rejections.

What we looked at in the standup:
- Metrics reviewed: per-pool CPU/GPU utilization, request size distribution, KV-cache hit-rate, token validation latency histogram.
- Routing config snapshot from 2026-12-09 02:58 UTC compared to current. Noted that routing weights for "customer-tier:free" were increased by 30% accidentally in the float delta.
- Autoscaler change (PLAT-1345) rolled at 02:45 UTC: max-pods-per-pool lowered from 24 -> 12 for cost tranche testing; combined with weight change created high queue length.

Decisions/Immediate mitigations taken during incident:
- Rolled back autoscaler delta to 24 at 04:05 UTC (Ethan).
- Reverted routing weight bump for free tier back to previous percentage at 04:18 UTC (Sofia).
- Temporarily disabled strict routing cutoff to allow polite overflow -> reduced quota rejections to 0.05% within 20 minutes (Priya).

Action items (owners + due):
- Action: Add a pre-merge lint check to prevent simultaneous weight changes + autoscaler edits in the same release window (owner: Priya) — due 2026-12-20.
- Action: Implement a lightweight canary for token validation latency that triggers a soft alert when 95th percentile > 40ms (owner: Maya/SRE) — due 2026-12-16.
- Action: Add a routing policy guard that prevents >15% delta to a single weight in a 1-hour window without a review tag (owner: Sofia) — due 2026-12-18.
- Action: Postmortem draft for PLAT-1345 incident (owner: Luca) — initial draft by 2026-12-15; full review 2026-12-17.
- Action: Add test harness in staging to simulate auth token churn and measure queueing behavior (owner: Ethan) — due 2026-12-21.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Need to map which customers on free-tier actually hit the Dedicated eu-west pool vs hosted API — seems config overlap in routing rules (ticket: PLAT-1402).
- Consider adding short-circuit fallback to cheaper quantized model when queue depth > X to preserve latency SLOs (brainstorm item).
- Investigate whether KV-cache invalidations lined up with token churn windows; hypothesis: concurrent cache evictions amplified validation latency.

Non-blocking follow-ups:
- Run a 48-hour smoke test with autoscaler cap at 18 and routing weight guards enabled in staging before pushing to prod (owner: Priya).
- Update the console dashboard to show "routing-change window" annotations (owner: Product—TBD).

Quick wins we can do this sprint:
- Add one alert rule: routing-config-delta > 10% in 30m -> pager (low severity) (owner: Sofia)
- Add a short README for on-call about manual mitigations (disable cutoff, rollback weight) (owner: Luca)

Random notes / informal fragments captured during the meeting (raw):
- "If we had a simple signal that combined queue length + token-validation p95 we would have triaged faster."
- "Maybe the sig-routing channel should have an ownership rota for weight changes."
- "We should avoid scheduling autoscaler experiments during the weekly deploy window (Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC)."

Linked tickets referenced during runbook:
- PLAT-1345 (autoscaler delta rollout)
- PLAT-1402 (routing overlap investigation)
- PLAT-1410 (token validation perf)

Next check-in: quick sync in #sig-routing on 2026-12-15 09:00 UTC to review postmortem progress.

Status: draft — want folks to drop comments inline in this doc. If no objections, convert to postmortem + runbook update by 2026-12-17.

---
Note to self: capture the small lua filter snippet used to detect >15% weight delta and paste into the runbook before finalizing.

End of notes.
